description: Run the AI roundup series for a creator: ingest curated source pages (source_posts), extract news stories, verify each against a primary source (official blog, GitHub repo, announcement), dedupe against past roundups, rank, and save drafts: an X thread, a branded LinkedIn document carousel, a companion video draft, and on weekly runs a deep-dive/hot-take post. Unverified stories are dropped. Drafts only; nothing is scheduled or published.

eval_run.description: QA runs: drafts are stamped eval_run and stay out of the review queue.

new_post.description: True only when the creator explicitly asked for a separate/new post.

target_post_id.description: The post open in the editor. The matching draft updates it in place (prior version kept) instead of creating a new post. Omit only when the creator explicitly asks for a new post.

workspace_id.description: Optional; defaults to the creator's workspace.

name: bamf.run_ai_roundup
